questions.title: Something in the Water
questions.prompt: Jacky dreamed Uncle Ruckus was his waiter. What kept happening no matter which drink he ordered?
options: A small fish was put in it
It arrived in a soup bowl
The waiter drank half of it first
questions.explanation: Changing the drink did nothing. The small fish was apparently standard service.

receipts.text: Had a crazy dream tho I was sitting at a restaurant and uncle ruckus was a waiter and kept putting a small fish in whatever drink I got

questions.title: The Next Stage
questions.prompt: In Lucas's Noodle dream, dogs at the cong turned into girls who said someone at a nearby Airbnb had transformed them. What happened when Lucas, Zach and Nico investigated?
options: They were entered in a dog show
They landed in a platformer level with rising water
They had to run the Airbnb's front desk
questions.explanation: They were doing well until the water started rising stupidly fast and everyone lost. The investigation had become a timed level.

receipts.text: We’re chilling til all these dogs get into the house, eventually they turn into girls and tell us about how they were at an Airbnb nearby and someone snuck in and turned them into dogs. For some reason me, zach and Nico check it out and we’re transported to some platformer level with rising water
We were doing good then the water started rising stupid fast and we all lost

questions.title: The Forbidden Meal Prep
questions.prompt: A ridiculous MyFitnessPal protein entry sent Jimmy and his group members into a serious logistics discussion. What were they trying to work into a balanced diet?
options: Aquarium fish flakes
A gallon of movie-theater butter
Dog food
questions.explanation: Ronan asked how a 200-gram serving could contain 600 grams of something. Jimmy knew the entry was nonsense; the dog-food meal-planning discussion happened anyway.

receipts.text: Jimmy how is there gonna be 600 grams of something in a 200 gram serving
That’s why it’s funny bruh the app told him that was the ratio
But it did cause me and my group members to discuss the logistics of working dog food into a balanced diet

questions.title: Above the Partition

receipts.text: I must say, some of yall blessed u will never experience shitting next to another tall person and making eye contact over the top of the stall standing up by accident

questions.title: Invoice Pending

questions.title: Spread the Workload
questions.prompt: In Jimmy's account of a particularly unnecessary bathroom visit, how did he use three consecutive stalls?
options: He tested each one for the best acoustics
He moved each time someone entered the room
He pooped in each one without flushing any
questions.explanation: One visit, three stalls, zero flushes. Jimmy described a distribution strategy nobody had requested.

receipts.text: pooped in a stall, then walked into the next stall and pooped in it, then the 3rd and pooped in it, and I didn’t flush any of them

As preparation for a competitive-eating event
